_description: LOTRO-TTS Custom NPC Overrides. Entries defined here take precedence over npc_races.json and NPC.xml both at runtime and during database generation (generate_db.py). This file is preserved across application updates.
_instructions: Define overrides at root level by NPC name (e.g. 'Peony Grubb') or NPC ID (e.g. '1879049636'). Supported fields: 'race', 'gender', and optional 'voice_id'.
